Selection_Basis: Official Nikkei selection rule explicitly defines sector balance using 6 sector categories consolidated from the 36 industrial classifications; component page independently encodes those sectors as parents of the 36 industries.

Officially valid finer child classification, but Nikkei identifies the 6 parent sectors as the sector-balance grouping for the Nikkei 225. This stage binds canonical Sector peer grouping to that explicit official parent role rather than the finer child level.
